description: Running variable must be supplied with observed units.
Known treatment-assignment threshold must be specified before analysis.
Sharp assignment rule must be verified from the institutional design.
Observed outcome variable must be supplied.
Likelihood for observations near the cutoff must be specified.
RD continuity assumption must be explicitly adopted and defended.
Running-variable manipulation must be assessed around the cutoff.
Sufficient observations must exist on both sides of the cutoff.
Local window or Bayesian local-function specification must be pre-specified.
